description.value: Viti Nordel is a wine and lager retail shop in North Delta, one of five Lower Mainland locations in the Viti Wine and Lager chain operated by the award-winning ViaggioHospitality group. The store offers a curated selection of wines, beers, and other beverages, and is positioned along a suburban commercial strip near the Nordel corridor. Touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley flatlands could stop here to pick up drinks for camp or an evening stay.
